en: Liquid water expands roughly 1,700 times in volume when it boils and changes into a gaseous state called steam.
Osmium is the densest natural solid element, weighing about twice as much as an equal volume of lead.
Ocean water is a liquid mixture containing approximately 35 grams of dissolved salts for every single liter.
Diamond is the hardest known natural solid material, scoring a perfect 10 on the Mohs hardness scale.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of all solid metals, turning liquid at 3,422 degrees Celsius.
A single tiny drop of liquid water contains approximately 1.5 sextillion individual water molecules.
Earth's gaseous atmosphere is a mixture containing roughly 78 percent nitrogen and 21 percent oxygen.
Solid carbon dioxide, called dry ice, changes directly into a gas at minus 78.5 degrees Celsius.
Pure solid gold is so malleable that one ounce can be hammered into a 9-square-meter sheet.
Liquid honey flows about 10,000 times slower than liquid water at standard room temperature.
Bronze is a solid metal mixture typically made of 88 percent copper and 12 percent tin.
Freezing one liter of liquid water into solid ice requires removing exactly 334,000 joules of thermal energy.
